waiting.title: The monorail at 60 and 120 rpm, on screen
waiting.what: You saw the monorail sets go choppy above 70 rpm. The motor's step is mended, and the train branch runs again after today's merge: all 51 train functions work, and the 6990 goes round its track at 60 and 120 rpm. No session can watch the animation as you see it (their panes are hidden), so only you can say whether it is smooth. The motor's own work leaves room for about 30 frames a second at 120 rpm.
